name: BN6's TagChips
why: BN6's NaviStats keep each folder's two TagChips at +0x56-0x59 (0xFF none, BN6_NAVI_FOLDER1_TAG); BN5 has no TagChips and holds 0 there. The spec's folders set none (src/dev/xdiff.c writes BN6's 0xFF where a spec names a folder).
evidence: BN6: each folder's two TagChips at +0x56 + 2 x its number (BN6_NAVI_FOLDER1_TAG), the NaviStats getter 0x080137B6 called with r1 0x56 + 2 x the folder at 0x08125876 and with 0x56 at 0x08138A76
BN5: no NaviStats getter is called with r1 0x56-0x59 (searched as for +0x3A)
